inventory_basis: read-only source, metadata, and filesystem inspection; no artifact import or CLI execution

python.source_syntax_floor_inferred: >=3.10 because source uses PEP 604 union annotations such as Path | None

runtime_dependencies.graph_learning: PyTorch Geometric 2.6.1; GCNConv, GATConv, SAGEConv, MessagePassing, PyG DataLoader and utility functions
runtime_dependencies.networkx: not listed and no networkx import found
runtime_dependencies.os_environment: no Dockerfile, Conda environment, pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, lockfile, or OS declaration found
runtime_dependencies.device: scripts default to --device cpu; source uses torch device placement and can accept another device string; no GPU requirement declared
runtime_dependencies.paper_host_context: paper reports Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS and CPU-only evaluation, but the artifact does not declare an OS image

data_and_schema.format: README states each .pt is a Python list of PyTorch Geometric Data objects

fields_consumed._VULN: node-level vulnerability/attack label; graph label is any positive node
fields_consumed._LINE: original node identifiers used for line-based localization

data_and_schema.auxiliary_label_file: pickle keyed by sample identifier with line-label information
data_and_schema.edge_features: none referenced by the package code; edge_weight is generated only as an explanation score
data_and_schema.raw_audit_logs: not included; README says original DARPA TC data remains subject to provider terms
data_and_schema.graph_construction_or_louvain: no raw-to-graph or Louvain preprocessing implementation found in the archive
data_and_schema.self_loop_behavior: detector/evaluation add remaining self-loops and coalesce; explainer removes existing self-loops, adds remaining self-loops for optimization, then removes them from output
data_and_schema.feature_dimension: not inspected by torch deserialization in R0; runtime scripts infer graph x.size(1) and compare it with checkpoint state

model.architecture: input Linear -> ReLU -> Linear to gnn_feature_dim_size; Linear -> ReLU -> Dropout; num_gnn_layers message-passing layers; ReLU/Dropout after each; configured global add/mean/max pool; 2-layer Linear/ReLU/Dropout/Linear classifier

training.loss: cross_entropy on graph labels from global max pooling of _VULN
training.checkpoint_outputs: model.bin and metadata.json under output-dir/dataset/gnn-model/checkpoint-best-acc and checkpoint-last
training.evaluation_during_training: each epoch evaluates validation and test partitions; best checkpoint selected by validation accuracy
training.seed_handling: random, PYTHONHASHSEED, numpy, torch.manual_seed, and torch.cuda.manual_seed are set in train_detector; deterministic algorithms are not enabled

phase_ii.optimizer: torch.optim.Adam on a randomly initialized per-edge mask
phase_ii.mask_mechanics: PyG MessagePassing explain masks are attached to message-passing modules; edge weight output is 1 - sigmoid(mask)
phase_ii.prediction_loss: relu(logits[:, target_label]).sum(), not a probability term as written in the paper
phase_ii.distance_loss: binary_cross_entropy(mask, ones_like(mask)) by default, or L1 norm of 1-mask; it is not BCE(mask, A_k) in the source
phase_ii.solidification: snapshot at int(epochs * stage_start_ratio); penalizes squared deviation for values below low or above high thresholds
phase_ii.target_label: defaults to the model's original predicted class; caller may override
phase_ii.output: PyTorch-saved list of graph_index, sample_id, edge_index, edge_weight, pred, and target_label

evaluation.localization: edge hit metrics from _VULN, or line-based metrics from optional sample_labels_all.pkl
evaluation.mer_intervention: remove selected top-K edges, zero x features of incident nodes, add self-loops, run the same detector without retraining, and compare argmax
evaluation.outputs: count, accuracy, precision, recall, f1, mer printed to stdout

package_inspection.purpose: loads sample data/checkpoint and performs a detector forward pass

phase_ii.purpose: loads a checkpoint, explains malicious graphs, and saves explanation tensors

pipeline.purpose: subprocesses train -> explain -> evaluate; defaults are a tiny smoke run

configs.random_seed_cli: training script exposes --seed; Phase-II script has no seed argument
